meta.title: Network Engineer Assistant (network-command-kb)
meta.description: A DeepSeek Harness plugin: a 17-platform / 130-document operations-and-command knowledge base covering network devices (Huawei, H3C, Ruijie, DPtech, Cisco IOS/NX-OS, Juniper Junos, Arista EOS, Fortinet FortiOS, ZTE ZXR10, VyOS, MikroTik RouterOS), Linux servers (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12, CentOS Stream 9 / Rocky Linux 9) and virtualisation/platform management (Proxmox VE 8/9, RosZ MCP platform), a loadable network-command-kb skill, the 网络工程师助手 agent preset, and a native MikroTik WinBox terminal tool (mt_winbox_exec, read-only by default).
